# External Market Datasets

This directory documents the external market datasets used by the trading research system.

The complete raw datasets remain on external storage because they are too large for the Git repository. The repository contains representative samples, schemas, manifests, source scripts, quality reports, and the complete compressed XAU/USD one-minute dataset.

## Datasets

| Dataset | Repository Content | Full External Dataset |
|---|---|---:|
| NAS100 | Tick and processed samples, scripts, reports and manifest | Approximately 11.33 GB |
| NQ futures | MBP-1 and trade samples plus manifest | Approximately 219.84 GB |
| XAU/USD | Complete one-minute Parquet dataset, reports and source script | Approximately 1.28 GB including raw ticks |

- [NAS100 documentation](nas100/README.md)
- [NQ documentation](nq/README.md)
- [XAU/USD documentation](xauusd/README.md)
